Incident Title: Authentication token expired after session refresh
Incident Description: Users are repeatedly signed out because authentication tokens refresh too early and expire before the app completes validation.
Resolution Details: Extended the session refresh window and aligned token expiry to the gateway timeout configuration

Incident Description: Checkout requests time out as the payment service hits upstream latency thresholds during peak traffic and causes incomplete purchases.
Resolution Details: Scaled the payment queue and set a fallback retry policy for timed-out transactions

Incident Description: Multiple order updates hit the same rows in opposite order, creating deadlocks and failed transactions for some customers.
Resolution Details: Reordered queries and added a lock timeout to reduce contention on the order table

Incident Description: The dashboard reloads but loses the session state and displays a blank page when the client tries to rehydrate cached data.
Resolution Details: Replaced stale session state with a refresh-safe token and cleared the cached screen state on reload

Incident Description: Users experience intermittent disconnects from the VPN during unstable network conditions and remote sessions drop when the gateway fails over.
Resolution Details: Adjusted failover thresholds and moved remote traffic to a more stable gateway region

Incident Description: A recent index change caused slower search completion times for product queries and increased p95 latency for some customer requests.
Resolution Details: Reverted the index update and rebuilt the search index using a smaller candidate set for local queries

Incident Title: Infrastructure node restart after disk failure
Incident Description: One cluster node restarted after a disk failure and caused workload churn before the service recovered.
Resolution Details: Replaced the failing node and restored the cluster health checks after the disk was repaired

Incident Description: Refund requests remain pending after status transitions because the approval service ignores the updated transaction state.
Resolution Details: Corrected the state transition events and reprocessed the queued approval jobs

Incident Title: Database replication delay after ETL run
Incident Description: Replication lag increases sharply after ETL jobs run concurrently and slows the analytical dashboards.
Resolution Details: Reduced the ETL concurrency and aligned the sync schedule with lower-load windows

Incident Description: The SSO redirect fails after a domain change because the callback URL does not match the service provider configuration.
Resolution Details: Updated callback URLs and verified the redirect chain after the provider configuration change

Incident Description: The checkout modal closes unexpectedly when users click outside the modal area and causes interruption in the order flow.
Resolution Details: Added click-outside rules and validation checks to keep the order modal stable until submission

Incident Description: Chart rendering slows down because a large dataset is loaded without filtering, affecting response time for monthly reporting.
Resolution Details: Reduced the chart payload and moved filtering to the backend before the chart request is rendered
